integrity: An explicit quotient decomposition and exact rational sign factorizations establish the theorem for every admissible integer pair and positive real conductance. Independent finite rational matrix tests support, but do not replace, the infinite-domain proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only two noise-free leaders on two unit-edge cliques of orders at least three joined by one positive-weight bridge; unscaled grounded-Laplacian inverse trace. Does not address multiple bridges, nonuniform clique edges, different objectives or finite-gain leaders. Independent publication-priority verification is not asserted.
title: A sharp bridge-conductance transition in optimal two-leader placement on unequal clique barbells
